releaseJsonVersionObject.promotionalText: Private cadet rosters, event photo search, clearer match ranges, reliable previews, saved finds, family notes, and a plain-English academy terms guide.
releaseJsonVersionObject.description:
CadetCatch helps Coast Guard Academy families keep up with cadet photos without digging through every gallery by hand.

Create a private roster on your iPhone, add a clear cadet photo, search event photos for possible matches, review likely finds, save photos to your iPhone Photos library, and keep simple notes for family follow-up.

CadetCatch shows possible matches for you to review. For best results, use a clear photo where only your cadet is visible.

Privacy Policy: https://cadetcatch.com/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
releaseJsonVersionObject.whatsNew: CadetCatch build 97 adds privacy-protected app measurement for completed photo checks and verified StoreKit purchases while preserving the paid access gate, approved $12.99 Family Monthly path, and reliable matched-photo previews.

On 2026-07-13 Firebase project cadetcatch and iOS app stream 15250018699 were registered for co.eb28.cadetcatch, and the Firebase-generated production configuration was merged with the existing Google Sign-In OAuth keys.

Runtime logging confirmed Firebase Analytics 12.16.0 initialized against the CadetCatch app ID without IDFA identity support. The invalid long-form ad-personalization user property was replaced with Google's supported GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_DEFAULT_ALLOW_AD_PERSONALIZATION_SIGNALS=false Info.plist control.

The GA4 link request to Google Ads customer 430-105-5805 was submitted with personalized advertising OFF, auto-tagging ON, and embedded Analytics-edit access from Ads OFF; Ads-side approval remains pending.

Firebase Realtime Analytics received first_open, session_start, and user_engagement from the unsigned CadetCatch simulator build, confirming event delivery to the registered project without claiming production App Store distribution.

GA4 key event photo_check_completed was created with no default monetary value and once-per-event counting. Google's native in_app_purchase and App Store subscription key events remain the revenue goals; low-intent funnel events were not promoted to key events.
